# meltcloud_foundry_versions (Data Source)

The Foundry versions a `meltcloud_foundry` can run. Needs the API Key of the admin Organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meltcloud_foundry_versions" "all" {}

# the newest foundry version on the stable channel
locals {
  newest_stable_foundry = [
    for version in data.meltcloud_foundry_versions.all.versions : version.name
    if contains(version.channels, "stable") && !version.revoked
  ][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) The Foundry versions this installation knows, newest first (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `channels` (List of String) Release channels the version is on, for example `stable`
- `eol_date` (String) Date the version stops being supported
- `name` (String) Name of the Foundry version, as its `version` takes it
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the version was withdrawn. A revoked version cannot be updated to
